newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's lower house approves telecoms bill.
newsitem.headline: Italy's lower house approves telecoms bill.

text.p: Italy's Chamber of Deputies (lower house) on Wednesday approved a bill paving the way for privatisation of state telecoms holding Stet.

The bill, which still needs final approval from the Senate (upper house), was approved by 224 to 42 with 142 abstentions. It creates a telecoms sector regulatory watchdog which is a prerequisite to the privatisation of Stet.
Stet is due to merge on Friday with its main operating unit Telecom Italia. The new enlarged group will be called Telecom Italia and it is scheduled for privatisation in mid-October.
The government has already laid out the guidelines for the privatisation of Telecom Italia in a separate decree.
The watchdog bill was expected to go to a vote in the lower house next week, but the government late Tuesday night pushed it up on the schedule.
The bill is due to the Senate at the end of the month.
